fields.title: Staff of Administration for AI Innovation Challenge (AIC)
fields.description:
Supported the participant-facing administrative operations throughout the competition. My responsibilities included verifying registration documents and participant eligibility, monitoring submissions, tracking seminar attendance for bonus-point calculation, and handling administrative issues such as incomplete documents and eligibility discrepancies.

I also managed participant communications through Discord by delivering competition announcements and responding to administrative inquiries. The role involved supporting a participant pool of 1,357 participants organized into teams of 3–5, while coordinating task distribution and administrative workflows with PICs and fellow committee members. I worked primarily with the competition’s admin dashboard, Discord, and Google Sheets.
